lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12-15 high-luminance circular blobs arranged in a staggered grid posterior to the gill slits. The pattern consists of roughly three horizontal rows with horizontal spacing wider than vertical spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of slightly higher pixel intensity align with the vertical axes of the high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like visual structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features running parallel to the longitudinal axis, defined by a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to low luminance shadows on the ventral side of the ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 4-6 distinct, high-intensity blobs visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, distributed primarily along the posterior edge and center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, prominent white/pale linear scar tissue extending vertically from the dorsal region down to the pectoral fin, with a deep indentation or partial amputation visible on the leading edge of the pectoral fin. Additional irregular pale striations present on the anterior dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme indentation or notch on the pectoral fin, appearing as a structural loss of fin tissue.
